name: Scripps Beach, La Jolla
notes: Reef break, best at mid-high tide. Point La Jolla shadows S/SSW swell; strongest on W/NW.

name: Law Street Beach, Pacific Beach
notes: Sandy beach break with shifting sandbars; softer and slower than surrounding breaks, best on west/northwest swell with east offshore wind

name: Ocean Beach (OB Pier)
notes: Beach and reef break, shifty and unpredictable; holds up to 8ft, best on west groundswell at low-mid tide
